{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Since sklearn is not available, use stratification by severity and site to compute adjusted difference in proportions

# Define strata: combinations of site and severity
strata = df[['site', 'severity']].apply(lambda x: '_'.join(x.astype(str)), axis=1)

# Compute response rate within each stratum
stratum_rates = df.groupby(['arm', strata])['responded'].mean().reset_index()

# Compute the number of patients in each stratum-arm combination
stratum_counts = df.groupby(['arm', strata]).size().reset_index(name='n')

# Merge rates and counts
stratum_data = pd.merge(stratum_rates, stratum_counts, on=['arm', strata])

# Compute weighted average response rate by arm, using stratum sizes as weights
# Weighted average = sum(n_i * p_i) / sum(n_i)
treatment_weighted_rate = (stratum_data[stratum_data['arm'] == 'treatment']['n'] * 
                            stratum_data[stratum_data['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded']).sum() / 
                           stratum_data[stratum_data['arm'] == 'treatment']['n'].sum()

control_weighted_rate = (stratum_data[stratum_data['arm'] == 'control']['n'] * 
                         stratum_data[stratum_data['arm'] == 'control']['responded']).sum() / 
                        stratum_data[stratum_data['arm'] == 'control']['n'].sum()

# Compute adjusted treatment effect
adjusted_effect = treatment_weighted_rate - control_weighted_rate

# Print results
treatment_weighted_rate, control_weighted_rate, adjusted_effect"}
